items.title: Microsoft 365: Frontier expands to public previews in Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, and SharePoint
items.description: Frontier is expanding to bring eligible public preview features across Microsoft 365 into one program. Users enrolled in Frontier can get eligible previews for new Outlook for Windows, OneDrive, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Copilot, managed through a single admin-controlled enrollment experience. Frontier enrollment is optional and separate from Standard and Deferred release preferences for generally available features. Existing Frontier users do not need to re-enroll.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Activity in other accounts and orgs improvements
items.description: Stay up-to-date with what's happening in your other accounts and organizations with the 'Activity in Other Accounts and Orgs' panel. Preview and open chats, channels, and other activity in other accounts and orgs from your main Teams window, without switching tenants.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Education] Create multi-week unit plans with Teach
items.description:
Educators can use Teach in Microsoft 365 Copilot to create structured unit plans that span multiple lessons or weeks. They can customize the plan components to organize connected lesson plans and quizzes across a unit.
#education

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Sustainability Management - Add EUDR certification information
items.description:
Record EUDR certification information for items under the EU Deforestation Regulation. Different lots of the same item can carry different certificates, origins and validity, it is stored on Lot No. Information, not on the item. An item is opted in with a single EUDR Relevant flag on the Item Card, which enforces lot tracking with lot information. Certificate data can be printed on a new EUDR Sales Invoice.
Certificate fields: EUDR Certificate No.; Certification Scheme; Valid From; Valid To; Cou

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Select Password from the context menu
items.description: Users can now manually access saved credentials when password suggestions don't appear automatically. When a user right-clicks a recognized username or password field, a new Select Password option appears in the context menu. This provides a reliable fallback path for sign-in scenarios where autofill suggestions are not surfaced, reducing the need for users to copy credentials manually. No configuration is required, and existing password management policies continue to apply.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI Interpreter for Teams Events
items.description: AI Interpreter for Events brings real-time, AI-powered audio interpretation to Teams Town Halls and Webinars, helping global audiences follow events in their preferred language. Organizers can configure supported languages for their event, giving attendees a more natural and engaging multilingual experience beyond translated captions.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Event Chat now available for Events optimized for a large audience in GCC, GCC High and DoD
items.description: All users in Events larger than 1,000 users or in any Event optimized for a large audience can now chat with one another in a public event chat in GCC, GCC High and DoD.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors will support write, update and delete actions
items.description: Federated Copilot connectors (MCP type) currently let Microsoft 365 Copilot read data from third-party services in real time. With this update, the connector tools that create, update, and delete content in those services are unblocked in Copilot Chat, so users can complete work without leaving Copilot. Copilot acts with the user's own account and permissions at the third-party service, and every create, update, or delete action requires the user's explicit confirmation before it runs. Admins ca

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Autolaunch opt-in experience for managed devices
items.description: Microsoft Edge will introduce an opt-in experience that allows users on managed devices to choose whether Edge launches automatically when Windows starts. Administrators can also manage this behavior through the LaunchEdgeOnWindowsStartupEnabled policy with opt-in, opt-out, and user-choice configurations.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
items.description: The Unified Classification Management Experience unifies every classifier in Microsoft Purview—Sensitive Information Types (SITs), Exact Data Match (EDM), fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into one place to discover, create, validate, and manage classifiers.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.156 - Improvements to site permissions user interfaces
items.description: To better align with user expectations, site permissions are changing to look and work both in context on a website that is requesting permissions and when navigating to permissions from Settings. On a website that is requesting permissions, there are changes to the Omnibox and the Page Info dialog and permissions will be easier to see and modify in Settings.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.156 - Enhanced Autofill
items.description: For desktop users, Microsoft Edge can now autofill additional document types—including passports, driver’s licenses, and other specialized forms—on top of your saved addresses.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
items.description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Engage Community feed improvements
items.description: Align the community feeds default experience with expected user behaviors; support triage and content review for users who want to read every message in a community.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Ground Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Edge for Business
items.description: Get relevant answers and insights about your open browser tabs and YouTube videos directly from the Edge side pane

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Enable fulfillment optimization in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
items.description:
Distributed order management (DOM) can now optimize fulfillment for standard sales orders in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. Previously, DOM was available only for Dynamics 365 Commerce orders. Now you can use the same rules-based fulfillment engine to automatically choose the best site and warehouse for each sales order line, without depending on Commerce or retail configuration.
This feature includes:

DOM for standard sales orders: Eligible Supply Chain Management sales orders are picke

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Check margins when overriding prices in Unified pricing management
items.description:
Price override allows sales representatives to adjust the preset price of a product during a transaction—typically for business purposes such as customer negotiations and retention. Previously, price override validation only enforced amount-based thresholds, without evaluating how the override would impact profit margins. Unified pricing management now provides margin check capabilities for price overrides across all order entry channels available in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.
Orders

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Enhance positive pay file generation through batch processing
items.description: This feature improves the scalability and performance of positive pay file generation by enabling the process to run as a background batch job. Organizations that generate large positive pay files can now offload processing from the interactive user session, reducing the risk of timeouts and improving the overall user experience. The enhancement is designed to support high-volume check payment scenarios while maintaining the existing positive pay functionality and output formats.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Copilot studio cost controls in MAC
items.description:
We’re expanding cost management for Microsoft Copilot Studio into the Microsoft 365 admin center. This gives administrators a more centralized way to manage Copilot Credit spend across usage-based AI workloads while retaining Copilot Studio cost management capabilities in the Power Platform admin center.
With this update, administrators can bring supported Copilot Studio environments and agents under Cost Management spending policies. Resource-based policies for environments and agents are the f
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sustainability: Enhance external sustainability reporting
items.description: This feature delivers enhancements to the external reporting experience with an improved standards and assessments structure and enhanced search capabilities. Users can navigate standards, assessments, and concepts more efficiently, reducing time spent locating and managing reporting content across complex disclosures. New dimension visualizations provide clearer insight into the context of reported data, helping users better understand dimensional attributes and validate disclosures more accura

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Network analytics enhancements
items.description:
Network analytics updates are rolling out in Microsoft Viva Engage, giving corporate communicators and network admins more flexibility to analyze activity and engagement across their organization.
With this update, network analytics includes custom date ranges, faster activity data refreshes, updated dashboard and metric table designs, expanded organizational filters with search, and new people-manager filters for viewing direct reports or full reporting hierarchies. These enhancements make it e

items.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence:  Biometric authentication
items.description: Voice biometric authentication delivers business value by reducing fraud and agent operating costs in contact centers. Voice-based verification improves identity assurance shortens call durations reduces customer service rep effort and enable secure self-service transactions. At the same time, it improves customer experience and scalability by authenticating callers naturally as they speak. This enables consistent, risk-based security across high call volumes without adding authentication fricti

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Shared analytics foundation for historical reporting
items.description: Dynamics 365 Customer Service provides out-of-the-box historical reporting built on a shared analytics foundation: a scalable, open, and AI-ready data foundation for Customer Experience and AI analytics scenarios across Dynamics 365. It uses a lakehouse-based architecture that can scale with data volume, supports curated analytics datasets for direct querying, and enables consistent reporting and semantic definitions across reports, agents, and copilots.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Create expenses from credit card feeds
items.description:
Expense Agent now supports creating expenses from imported credit card transaction feeds or automatically reconcile with them if the expense was created earlier. Key capabilities include:

Import credit card transaction data and review it in the web and mobile apps.
Automatically create expenses from imported card transactions.
Match imported transactions to existing expenses, where applicable.
Reduce duplicate data entry by leveraging transaction details already captured from credit card feeds.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Decline a call with a message on Mobile
items.description: Users can quickly decline an incoming Teams call and send a predefined message to the caller at the same time. From the incoming call screen, users can select a message such as letting the caller know they're unavailable or will call back, providing helpful context without having to answer the call or separately open a chat.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: External presenter support for event group chat
items.description: Event group chat, the private chat for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters in an event or structured meeting, will support external presenters.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Start side conversations during meetings
items.description: Keep collaboration moving without disrupting the main discussion. Start and continue one-to-one or small-group conversations directly from a meeting to ask questions, coordinate next steps, share information, and collaborate in parallel while staying engaged in the conversation, reducing context switching and helping teams stay focused and productive.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Two presenters can share their screens or windows simultaneously in meetings
items.description: Two presenters can share a screen or window at the same time in a Teams meeting. Participants can see both shared content streams simultaneously, making it easier to compare and discuss content from different presenters.

items.title: Outlook: All Day events to show up more clearly in the Mail module Calendar Preview
items.description: We're making it easier to tell when receiving meeting invites that conflict with scheduled Out of Office time or Busy All Day events, on Outlook Web and Outlook for Windows.

items.title: Outlook: Sort improvements to the message list
items.description: When sorting on Outlook for Web or Outlook for Windows, if the Sort By field is not one of From, Subject, or Date Received, we will now show an additional column for the Sort By value (e.g., Size). We will also support sorting by Flag Due Date.

items.title: Outlook: Variable number of message preview lines
items.description: Outlook for Windows and Outlook for Web will now allow users to modify how the preview text for emails show in the message list. The preview text can now take up 2 lines, 1 whole line, or 0 additional lines.

items.title: Outlook: All Accounts view (Unified Inbox) brings your email into a single inbox view
items.description: The All-Accounts view, also known as Unified Inbox, lets you see emails from multiple accounts in a single inbox view in the new Outlook for Windows, without merging your mailboxes.   Each account's inbox stays separate; the view brings them together so you can triage in one place.  Users can read, delete, move, archive, and mark messages across accounts without switching between mailboxes.   The experience integrates with Copilot for AI-assisted email workflows and supports Immersive Search for

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

items.title: Microsoft Teams: New sharing panel in meetings - improved content discovery and ease of sharing
items.description: The sharing panel in today’s meetings is the default place for content discoverability and sharing.  New sharing panel UI is crafted with intent of modernising and simplifying default tasks such as window sharing, but also for easier discovery of sharing options and more discoverable file sharing.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Scanner data export for custom reporting
items.description: Learn about the state of your scanned repositories and create custom reports with the information protection scanner. Labeling, classification and protection actions on scanned files are stored in SQL tables that form a foundation to feed into custom reports.
